patch_description: The current local search only uses adjacent swaps, which can't move a misplaced block of transactions to a better position. Or-opt moves—removing a segment of length 1–3 and reinserting it at every other position—complement swaps by relocating transactions across long distances. We alternate swap passes and Or-opt passes until no improvement, evaluating each candidate with `get_opt_seq_cost`. This strictly improves the makespan found by the greedy construction phase.
